profiles.full: Production graph: ambiguity analysis, examples, deterministic repair and up to three LLM repairs.
profiles.simplified: Same graph, draft/refine model and deterministic skeleton/repair; no ambiguity LLM, example retrieval or LLM repair.

scoring: Final HTTP assertions run once after generation and are not supplied to model repair. Invalid protocol must re-interrupt before render. Compiler fault is injected identically in both profiles.
acceptance_policy: Do not tune generation on acceptance results during this benchmark version. Any future tuning promotes those tasks to development and requires new acceptance tasks.
